old_caption: The video begins with a nighttime scene featuring a bridge illuminated by lights reflecting on a calm body of water. The background is dark, with silhouettes of trees and hills barely visible against the night sky. As time progresses, the sky transitions from dark to lighter shades, indicating the approach of dawn. Clouds start to move across the sky, gradually revealing more details of the landscape. By the midpoint of the video, the sky becomes brighter, and the clouds are more prominent, casting a soft light over the scene. The reflection of the lights on the water remains consistent throughout, creating a serene and tranquil atmosphere. The transition from night to day is smooth, with the changing light and cloud movement providing a dynamic backdrop to the static elements of the bridge and the water.

caption: A calm lake fills the lower frame, bordered by a black tree-covered hill and a heavily clouded sky. A horizontal row of evenly spaced warm lights spans the waterline, each casting a vertical golden reflection, while a bright light anchors the right edge and a faint green glow sits at the left. Overall luminance climbs steadily and monotonically, the scene lifting from near-black toward dim twilight with no shift in camera angle or object position. As the light rises, the cloud structure resolves, a brighter mass gathering at the upper left. The hill's silhouette softens from pure black into a textured dark-green mass of foliage. Bridge arches beneath the lamps become faintly discernible, and the small green hillside dot and left-edge glow grow slightly more visible. The warm lights and their mirror reflections hold constant in position and color, with only a slight shimmer on the water.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
